metadata.source_filename_n1: n1 appears in the filename; replicate type is not specified.

notes: The three detailed context sheets are imported once. Summary Sheet repeats those results and is not a biological replicate.
Context labels are preserved exactly as written in the detailed sheets; no transfection orientation or NanoBRET target assignment is inferred.
No CypA and +CypA are separate source conditions. Concentration, incubation time, biological replicate type and assay acceptance thresholds are not supplied.
Total crosslinking is the sum of the reported one-or-more-adduct percentages. Percentages are preserved without forcing their sum to 100.
Fold change is +CypA / No CypA. Differences are +CypA − No CypA, in percentage points. A zero denominator remains undefined.
Crosslinking is not EC50 or NanoBRET Cmax. NanoBRET hit cutoffs do not classify these results. No significance tests or error bars are inferred from this single source dataset.
Full RMC IDs, including batch suffixes, are matched exactly. Additional IDs remain separate.
Structure SMILES and warhead annotations from Summary Sheet are not included in this assay-results import.
